# google_storage_control_project_feature_config

Get information about a Cloud Storage Control ProjectFeatureConfig.

~> **Warning:** This datasource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.


## Example Usage

```hcl
data "google_storage_control_project_feature_config" "default" {
  provider = google-beta
  feature_config_id = google_storage_control_project_feature_config.example.feature_config_id
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `feature_config_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the feature configuration, which becomes the final component of its resource name.
  The ID must be 1 to 63 characters long, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only
  lowercase letters, digits, and dashes. The last character can't be a dash.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
